summary.one_liner: Maccy is a lightweight, keyboard-first clipboard manager for macOS that keeps a searchable history of copied items.
summary.what_it_does: Maccy records what you copy and lets you search and reuse earlier clipboard contents from a popup window or menu bar icon. You can select an item to copy it, paste it directly, or paste it without formatting, using keyboard shortcuts. Items can be deleted, pinned to stay at the top of the list, and cleared in bulk, with pinned items optionally included. Ignore options cover copying sensitive data: a global ignore switch set via the defaults command, a one-off ignore of the next copy, and ignoring specific pasteboard types such as those used by password managers. The clipboard check interval is configurable through defaults. Preferences include an option to paste automatically.
use_cases: Search through previously copied text on a Mac
Paste earlier clipboard items without re-copying
Keep sensitive copies out of clipboard history
Pin frequently used snippets to the top of history
Troubleshoot clipboard manager paste or shortcut issues
how_to_run: Or download the latest version from the releases page
Press SHIFT + COMMAND + C to open Maccy
Optional: defaults write org.p0deje.Maccy ignoreEvents true
notable: Pinned items get a random but permanent keyboard shortcut
Ignores concealed and transient pasteboard types by default, such as those used by password managers
Can ignore the Universal Clipboard via a pasteboard type setting
Configurable via defaults commands and a Preferences window
README warns that maccy.app is the only official website
caveats: Keyboard shortcuts may stop working in password fields when they produce characters, requiring a workaround with Karabiner-Elements
Paste-on-select needs Accessibility permission granted in System Settings
